hypotheses.subject: Brazilian transmission concessions and renewable evacuation
hypotheses.perspective: Transmission developers, grid-equipment suppliers and renewable generators
hypotheses.condition: ANEEL reports that all eight lots in the 30 October 2026 auction were awarded, with R$8.8bn reported investment, 1,866 km of lines and 12,694 MVA of transformation capacity; MME reports R$8.9bn for the same auction.
hypotheses.mechanism: The awards create a project pipeline that may expand transfer capacity if contracts, finance, licensing, construction and commissioning proceed; this is an evidence update to existing BRA-GRID-001, not proof of new installed capacity.
hypotheses.trigger: Signed contracts, project-level financing, procurement, construction and commissioning; measured transfer capacity, curtailment and reliability.
hypotheses.invalidation: Cancelled or delayed contracts, no financing or commissioning, or no measured improvement in the relevant grid constraints.

hypotheses.subject: Uzbekistan electricity-distribution modernization
hypotheses.perspective: Grid users, renewable developers and equipment suppliers
hypotheses.condition: World Bank/ADB financing and a 60-substation programme are already staged; no new execution milestone was found.
hypotheses.mechanism: Modernization could reduce losses and enable renewables only after disbursement, procurement and commissioning.
hypotheses.trigger: Verified disbursements, contract awards, commissioned substations and measured losses.
hypotheses.invalidation: No implementation progress or no measured operating improvement.

hypotheses.subject: Korean electrical-equipment exports for grid and AI infrastructure
hypotheses.perspective: Manufacturers and buyers of transformers, cables and grid equipment
hypotheses.condition: The existing 1 November signal records a nominal October export record; no new volume or customer-level commissioning data were found.
hypotheses.mechanism: Export receipts may indicate demand but do not establish physical capacity or margins.
hypotheses.trigger: Additional customs volumes, order backlogs, delivery destinations and commissioned projects.
hypotheses.invalidation: Nominal values reverse or no customer/project delivery is established.

hypotheses.subject: Asia DRIVE energy-resilience credit fund
hypotheses.perspective: Private infrastructure developers seeking long-tenor financing
hypotheses.condition: The existing 2 November signal tracks an announced US$750m target fund and up-to US$50m IFC participation; no new close or disbursement was verified.
hypotheses.mechanism: Risk-sharing capital may lower financing hurdles only if capital is raised and projects are funded.
hypotheses.trigger: Paid-in capital, financial close, named projects and disbursement.
hypotheses.invalidation: No close or no project-level financing.

hypotheses.subject: Hartha power-station outage in Iraq
hypotheses.condition: A fire reportedly halted operations at a plant operating at about 400 MW before the event; cause and restoration are unknown.
hypotheses.mechanism: A local outage may affect supply reliability, but no durable capacity gap or investment pathway is yet established.
hypotheses.trigger: Official cause, damage assessment, restoration date and verified grid operating data.
hypotheses.invalidation: Rapid restoration with no durable equipment or network constraint.

hypotheses.subject: Gulf maritime-security incident near Khasab
hypotheses.perspective: Shipping operators, insurers and energy cargo counterparties
hypotheses.condition: UKMTO incident is relayed by Reuters; vessel identity and actor attribution are unknown.
hypotheses.mechanism: A verified pattern of incidents could affect insurance and routing costs, but a single unresolved report does not establish a durable structural opportunity.
hypotheses.trigger: Direct UKMTO notices, vessel identity, verified damage, insurance quotes and route-level freight data.
hypotheses.invalidation: No confirmed incident linkage or no measurable change in shipping/insurance conditions.

reason_no_canonical_change: One evidence-update candidate was staged for task 2/5 review. No canonical snapshot or history event was changed because the auction award is not proof of financial close, construction, commissioning or measured operating impact.
